sections.text: BCOR encodes a BCL6-interacting transcriptional corepressor.

audit_evidence.location: NCBI Gene 54880 RefSeq/Alliance summary, inspected cached esummary record

sections.text: ZC3H7B::BCOR occurs in a subset of high-grade endometrial stromal sarcomas with spindle cells and myxoid stroma. It has also been molecularly validated in malignant ossifying fibromyxoid tumor.

audit_evidence.scope: YWHAE-NUTM2 high-grade round-cell tumors show diffuse BCOR; ZC3H7B-BCOR tumors show spindle/myxoid morphology with variable BCOR staining.
